meta.by: Claude, from the abstracts (PubMed) and earlier full texts

records.note: Fontaine 2004: the abstract says stimulation was used to treat both conditions, after Mallet 2002. Now a context record. (The frame's first ledger row had no title, so the screen showed only the abstract.)
Liu 2016: the title reads as deliberate treatment, but the PsycInfo abstract shows the dopamine was given for septic shock. Stays a case.
Romeo 2025: already excluded after full text on 17 Nov (semaglutide chosen partly for craving).
Miller 2012: the depression had already remitted with ECT; palatal expansion treated sleep-disordered breathing the authors set out to find as the cause.
Sabel'nikova 2013: schizophrenia unchanged after 8 months gluten-free (coeliac remitted).
Sciortino 2021: prefrontal stimulation easing binge eating was known after Downar 2012. Now a context record.
Guerdjikova 2026: no abstract, indication unstated, effect widely reported by 2026.
Kornhuber 1993: psychosis worsened on amantadine.
Serratrice 2002: sudden psychosis the authors attribute to coeliac disease.
Min 2022: switched from paroxetine to vortioxetine for the depression (conference abstract).
Kaltenboeck 2023: off-label esketamine aimed at the OCD and depression (settled 14 Nov).
Pintor 2022: a review chapter, kept as a context record, not a case.
Paulig 2001: gabapentin given for the Charles Bonnet hallucinations themselves; anticonvulsants had been tried for them before. Letter, no abstract.
Liu 2022: a prospective DBS series in Tourette syndrome with depression scores as a secondary outcome (Claude's first reason, E3, was the wrong code).
Bellamy 2025: ketogenic therapy aimed at the psychiatric syndromes.
Nygaard Andersen 2014: contraceptive-induced depression remitting when they stopped.
Albertini 2006: mirtazapine for compulsive masturbation, but the autism itself improved and the authors call that unexpected. Claude screened only the headline syndrome; to full text.
Takizawa 2026: GLP-1 drugs cutting drinking was expected by 2026; only one of three had alcohol use disorder.
Yashkov 2006: bariatric surgery offered as a treatment for severe bulimia.
Endres 2017: levetiracetam aimed at the psychosis through a hypothesised paraepileptic mechanism.
Shahani 2019: psychiatric syndromes of temporal lobe epilepsy improving with seizure control.
Adán 2005: psychosis appeared with vagus nerve stimulation.
